div.head: Wl art 6.3
div.ab: Si [autem] Anglus Francigen[a]m appellaverit et probare noluerit iudicio aut duello, volo tamen Francigenam purgare se sacramento non fracto.
If, however, an Englishman summons a Frenchman and declines to prove [the charge] by ordeal or by combat, it is my will that the Frenchman shall clear himself by a comprehensive oath.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 240–241 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text (K–M) not yet added
